notes: Lead: VP Product (Aisha Gomez) — building contextual in-product assistant for analytics product.
Initial POC started with Hosted API Jan 2026 — liked latency and throughput; moved to Dedicated evaluation for predictable load and data isolation.

Requirements: 95th pct latency < 200ms for short queries (chat quick answers), tail latency < 500ms under burst; 500 req/s sustained during peak reports. Cost-sensitivity: wants to keep token cost under $0.003/token equivalent for typical prompts.
Model preferences: prefer open LLaMA-derivative or Mistral family; want ability to route to a higher-accuracy variant for sensitive queries and a quantized low-cost variant for breadth queries.

Routing & resilience: want canary rollout for new model versions (10% traffic -> 50% -> 100%), automatic rollback on quality regression or latency spikes, fallback routing to alternate region (us-west <-> us-east) and to smaller cheaper model when Dedicated pool under pressure.
Security: enterprise SSO (SAML), KMS integration (AWS KMS), audit logs forwarded to Splunk, 7-year retention requirement for certain event types flagged by compliance team.

POC plan agreed: 4-week Dedicated POC in VPC — week1 infra + network setup; week2 canary + synthetic traffic validation; week3 customer real-traffic canary (10% sessions) + quality evals; week4 performance tuning and cost runbook, SLA language iteration.
Success criteria: latency SLOs met, <2% error rate for token generation, deterministic rollback within 5 minutes of alarm, and documented cost per 1M tokens under target.

Pricing conversation: AE presented Dedicated commit tiers; current ask: mid-market commit model (monthly reserved GPUs) with burst credits. Customer asked for 30-day trial pricing for Dedicated POC and a separate price schedule for 12-month commit.
